# What’s in my Fridge

> Snap your shopping and the AI turns what you’ve got into dinner — tracks freshness, cuts food waste, and tells you what to cook tonight. Free, no App Store.

## Pages

- [What’s in my Fridge — AI dinners from your fridge, less waste](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/): Snap your shopping and the AI turns what you’ve got into dinner — tracks freshness, cuts food waste, and tells you what to cook tonight. Free, no App Store.

## Guides

- [“There’s Nothing to Eat” — in a Full Fridge?](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/ask-your-fridge-what-to-cook/): A full fridge and still nothing to eat? Just ask — get meal ideas built only from what you actually have, plus what’s worth using up.
- [Veggie, Gluten-Free or Nut Allergy? Meal Ideas That Fit](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/diet-and-allergy-friendly-meal-ideas/): Vegetarian, gluten-free or a nut allergy? Set your diet once and every meal idea respects it — no more scrolling past meals you can’t eat.
- [Dinner From a Photo: Stop Staring Into the Fridge at 6pm](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/dinner-from-a-photo/): Sick of staring into the fridge wondering what to cook? Snap what you’ve got and get real dinner ideas you can actually make tonight — free.
- [Don't Know What to Cook? How to Beat the 6pm Stare](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/dont-know-what-to-cook/): A fridge full of food and still no idea what to make? Why the daily dinner decision is so draining, plus a simple method (and a smart app) to beat it fast.
- [Know the Dish, Not What’s Missing? Here’s the Fix](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/find-what-you-need-for-any-dish/): Fancy a specific dish but not sure what you’re missing? Name it and instantly see what you have vs what to buy — added to your list in a tap.
- [How Long Do Eggs Last? Fridge Times & the Float Test](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-do-eggs-last/): How long eggs last in the fridge, whether you can eat them after the best-before date, and the simple float test to check if an egg is still good.
- [How Long Do Leftovers Last in the Fridge?](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-do-leftovers-last-in-the-fridge/): How long cooked leftovers last in the fridge, the safe way to cool and reheat them, how long you can freeze them, and when to throw them out.
- [How Long Does Bread Last? (And Why Not the Fridge)](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-does-bread-last/): How long bread lasts at room temperature, why the fridge makes it go stale faster, how to freeze bread, and what to do about mould.
- [How Long Does Butter Last in the Fridge?](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-does-butter-last/): How long butter lasts in the fridge once opened, whether you can leave it out, how long it freezes for, and how to tell if butter has gone rancid.
- [How Long Does Cheese Last in the Fridge?](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-does-cheese-last-in-the-fridge/): How long hard and soft cheese last in the fridge once opened, how to store cheese properly, whether you can freeze it, and what to do about mould.
- [How Long Does Chicken Last in the Fridge? (Raw & Cooked)](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-does-chicken-last-in-the-fridge/): How long raw and cooked chicken last in the fridge and freezer, how to store it safely, and how to tell if chicken has gone off.
- [How Long Does Cooked Rice Last in the Fridge?](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-does-cooked-rice-last/): How long cooked rice keeps in the fridge, why rice can cause food poisoning, and how to cool, store and reheat it safely (NHS guidance).
- [How Long Does Food Last in the Fridge? UK Storage Chart](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-does-food-last-in-the-fridge/): How long milk, chicken, eggs, leftovers and veg really last in the fridge and freezer — a clear UK storage chart, plus where to store what and how to tell when food’s off.
- [How Long Does Milk Last in the Fridge? (Opened & Unopened)](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-does-milk-last/): How long milk lasts in the fridge opened and unopened, whether you can freeze it, and how to tell when milk has gone off.
- [How Long Does Spinach Last? (And How to Keep It Fresh)](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-long-does-spinach-last/): How long fresh and cooked spinach last in the fridge, how to store spinach so it doesn’t go slimy, and whether you can freeze it.
- [How to Organise Your Fridge: Shelf-by-Shelf UK Guide](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-to-organise-your-fridge/): Where every food goes in your fridge, the right temperature, and a simple system so nothing gets forgotten. Shelf-by-shelf, food-safe, and easy to keep up.
- [How to Stop Wasting Food at Home (and Save Money)](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/how-to-stop-wasting-food/): The average UK home bins around £700 of good food a year. Here are simple, realistic habits to waste less, eat better, and keep that money in your pocket.
- [Blog — Tips on Food Storage, Dinner Ideas & Cutting Waste](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/): Practical tips on fridge storage, easy dinner ideas from what you already have, and simple ways to waste less food and save money.
- [Never Forget Food at the Back of the Fridge Again](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/never-forget-food-at-the-back-of-the-fridge/): Tired of binning food you forgot you had? A simple fridge tracker flags what’s going off first, so you cook it in time and waste less.
- [Out of Coffee. Again. How to Never Run Out of Essentials](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/never-run-out-of-essentials/): Out of coffee, again? Mark your must-haves and get flagged the moment you run low — so milk, eggs, oil and coffee are always on the list in time.
- [Binning £60 of Food a Month? Here’s How to Keep It](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/save-60-pounds-a-month-on-food-waste/): The average UK home bins around £60 of food a month. Track what you have, cook what’s going off, and keep the cash — free to start.
- [The Shopping List That Builds Itself (and Sorts by Aisle)](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/smart-shopping-list-that-builds-itself/): Always forget the one thing you went for? A smart shopping list that builds itself from your meals and sorts by aisle — so you shop fast and forget nothing.
- [Recipes That Talk You Through It — Scaled to You](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/step-by-step-recipes-scaled-to-you/): Wish someone would just talk you through dinner? Get clear, step-by-step recipes with quantities scaled to however many you’re cooking for.
- [Track What’s in Your Fridge With One Photo (No Typing)](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/track-whats-in-your-fridge-app/): Tired of guessing what’s in your fridge? Snap your shopping and an AI fridge inventory app logs everything in seconds — no typing, filed where it lives.
- [What Can I Make for Dinner With What's in My Fridge?](https://www.whatsinmyfridge.co.uk/blog/what-can-i-make-for-dinner/): No idea what to cook? A simple formula for turning whatever's in your fridge into dinner, plus a by-ingredient cheat sheet and instant ideas from what you have.
